title: Automating Backtesting?
author: iiUrgency
selftext:
Okay I am a total noob at this but basically I am looking to back test some day trading strategies via ChatGPT (or any other AI you recommend) but I am having real trouble with getting the data to get meaningful test results.

ChatGPT had me connect it to Massive for the data, but can only get 3-5ish days of data at a time. It is doing minute-ticket charts so maybe thats the issue?

Honestly I am just a dumbass here and am wanting to try to see where I may have an edge before actually putting real money to it.

Please help this idiot out lol

comments.author: No_Appointment_6678
comments.body: Someone published a repo of his project that has a backtesting engine, I haven't tried it yet but it worth a look

comments.author: Used-Post-2255
comments.body: Many use daily, hourly data, you can even make 5 min aggregates. Obviously the bigger issue is you need some experience to lead the AI in the right direction. So your own time + focus and being less dependent on only AI answers is whats needed.

comments.author: RNAlgotrading
comments.body:
Did you try RN TradeLab from www.rnalgotrading.com?

It's completely free to use and Focus on data downloading, writing your first indicator, writing strategies, backtesting, optimising with in sample out of sample method, portfolio construction, live signals if live data is connected via API, and much more on knowledge base section.

No broker needed, no money needed.. just download and use it. It's purely educational Research platform and developed for early quants. Please drop your feedback if possible after using it.
